verdict.rationale: Gemini models are reachable beyond the ai.google.dev endpoint. Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform documents regional and global endpoints for Gemini model calls, and a community user points to OpenRouter serving gemini-3-pro-preview. There is no evidence of availability on Bedrock or Azure, and OpenRouter availability rests on one community comment, not vendor docs. Missing for 10: AWS Bedrock availability, Azure availability, first-party documentation of third-party gateway/router support, model-parity details across channels.

support.subject: As a founder, I can consume the same models through major clouds or gateways — Bedrock, Vertex, Azure, or OpenRouter-class routers — not only the vendor's own endpoint

citations.quote: Data stored at rest in the customer selected location remains at rest in that location, independent of the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform endpoint called by that customer's request.
openrouter.ai/google/gemini-3-pro-preview is useful to know about.
